title: Mad Love Chase
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kaito, prince of the demon realm, flees to the human world and lives as high-school student Kujou Yamato to escape an arranged marriage. His father sends a clumsy trio of demons to bring him back; since his looks have changed, they can only identify him by a mark on his back, so they keep trying to undress him.
life_message: Choosing your own life and loves matters more than duties imposed by family rank.
